name: God Made Us
overview: Scripture reveals that God is the sovereign Creator who made the heavens, the earth, and all living beings, including mankind, whom He fashioned in His own image. From the very beginning, God designed humanity perfectly, male and female, granting them dominion over creation. The Spirit of God imparts life, and even before birth, God is intimately involved in forming each person. All that God made was declared very good, reflecting His perfect design and purpose for humanity.
